svg.title: The single-agent searches in motion_planner
svg.desc: Static: which scheduler methods call which search function, which environment each search uses, and how BuildStaticObstacleFilter feeds all of them. Every search runs on the same SingleSourceSearch engine.

g.text: Task planning calls these searches while it builds the event DAG. They see only static obstacles through a filter and ignore everyone else's timing; only CHUGG, later, plans in time.
